name: Distance Partition and Arithmetic Threshold
description: Replaces the edge-removal/bridge condition with a distance-based partition ("closer to u or closer to v"), which mathematically evaluates to the exact same two components in a tree. Additionally, replaces the "both sides have at least one key node" condition with the mathematically equivalent arithmetic threshold "the absolute difference between the number of key nodes in the two sets is strictly less than t". This completely hides the Steiner tree / bridge-finding patterns while preserving the exact same O(N) solution.
